# Jonty Ali

> Jonty Ali ("Jomlom") studies maths and physics at Durham University and builds simulations, games and mods, writes puzzles and makes art. This is his personal site.

Email: contact@jontyali.com

## Pages

- [About](https://jontyali.com/about/): who he is
- [Projects](https://jontyali.com/projects/): everything he has built, live, in progress and ideas
- [Puzzles](https://jontyali.com/puzzles/): original logic and problem solving puzzles
- [Art](https://jontyali.com/art/): pixel art and paintings
- [Writeups](https://jontyali.com/writeups/): longer notes and articles
- [Log](https://jontyali.com/log/): occasional updates when something interesting happens
- [Contact](https://jontyali.com/contact/): email and profiles

## Projects

- [N-Body Gravity Simulator](https://jontyali.com/projects/nbody/): real-time gravity simulation of thousands of bodies on the GPU (WebGL2, GLSL). It runs in the background across this site.
- [Minecraft Mods](https://jontyali.com/projects/mcmods/): mods written in Java, with around 400k downloads of his own.
- [Chess Platform and Engine](https://jontyali.com/projects/chess/): a chess platform and engine in C++, aiming for a bot around 1600 ELO.
- [Into The Maze](https://jontyali.com/projects/itm/): a small indie game team with a friend, building a playable demo in Godot.
- [Poker Platform and Bots](https://jontyali.com/projects/poker/): an idea-stage poker platform with bots.
- [This website](https://jontyali.com/projects/site/): hand-built static site with no framework.
